caption: The drawing depicts a kitchen interior with a variety of objects and features. Along the left wall, there is a large wooden cupboard with open doors revealing neatly arranged dishes, cups, and bowls in white and muted colors. On the countertop beneath the cupboard, there is a breadbox, a coffee grinder, and several other small items. A black oil lamp is mounted on the left wall. In the left foreground, there is a wooden rocking chair on a blue oval braided rug. In the center, a wooden table with turned legs is covered partially by a red-and-white patterned cloth, upon which sits a pitcher, lamp, sugar bowl, teacup, plate with food, and a box labeled "COCOA." A chair with a straight back is positioned by the table. Behind the table, there are green lower cabinets, a white sink with a towel hanging over it, and an old-fashioned water pump. Above the sink are shelves with pink dishes and a framed mirror. In the right rear, an ornate, metallic gray wood-burning stove has a kettle and a frying pan on it, with a black stovepipe leading upward. To the right of the stove is a wall-mounted telephone and additional shelves holding containers and dishes. On the floor below the stove, firewood or stove accessories are visible. The wallpaper has a colorful, repeating geometric pattern dominated by shades of yellow, red, and green. The floor consists of brown wooden planks, and the ceiling is a muted light green shade. Various light sources include a hanging oil lamp at the center, another oil lamp on the wall, and a small candle on a wall-mounted holder above the stove. Several kitchen tools and objects are distributed on shelves and countertops throughout the space, contributing to a densely furnished kitchen scene.
title: Rural Kitchen
